faces.name: Consume the Meek
faces.oracleText: Destroy each creature with mana value 3 or less. They can't be regenerated.

faces.name: Consuming Aberration
faces.oracleText:
Consuming Aberration's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your opponents' graveyards.
Whenever you cast a spell, each opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then puts those cards into their graveyard.

faces.name: Consuming Aetherborn
faces.oracleText:
Backup 1 (When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. If that's another creature, it gains the following ability until end of turn.)
Lifelink

faces.name: Consuming Ashes
faces.oracleText: Exile target creature. If it had mana value 3 or less, surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

faces.name: Consuming Blob
faces.oracleText:
Consuming Blob's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
At the beginning of your end step, create a green Ooze creature token with "This token's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1."

faces.name: Consuming Bonfire
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Consuming Bonfire deals 4 damage to target non-Elemental creature.
• Consuming Bonfire deals 7 damage to target Treefolk creature.

faces.name: Consuming Corruption
faces.oracleText: Consuming Corruption deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life, where X is the number of Swamps you control.

faces.name: Consuming Ferocity
faces.oracleText:
Enchant non-Wall creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+0.
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+0 counter on enchanted creature. If that creature has three or more +1/+0 counters on it, it deals damage equal to its power to its controller, then destroy that creature and it can't be regenerated.
